levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن أبو الأسود

notes: «حيوة، وغيره، قالا» is a pair: «وغيره» (and another) is not named, so it is an unnamed co-transmitter
Ikrima is inside Abu al-Aswad's story but speaks («ثم قال أخبرني ابن عباس»): he relays from Ibn Abbas, so he is a link (rule 6); Ibn Abbas is the last link
«رواه الليث عن أبي الأسود» is a remark naming another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group
